tools.name: sb_get_public_app
tools.description: Look up a published Software Belongs app by exact slug. Unreleased and unknown apps are not exposed.

tools.name: sb_list_public_business_tools
tools.description: Find released Software Belongs business tools and their public descriptions, pricing mode, and website links.

tools.name: sb_pdf_merger_event
tools.description: Record a privacy-preserving, aggregate PDF Merger MCP App outcome. No document contents, file names, or user identifiers are accepted.

tools.name: sb_runtime_info
tools.description: Read the running Software Belongs public MCP version and public catalog tool inventory. Owner and administrative capabilities are not disclosed.

tools.name: sb_open_pdf_merger
tools.description: Open the free Software Belongs PDF Merger in an interactive MCP App. Select and reorder 2-20 PDFs and download the merged document. Files are processed locally in the UI and are never sent to this MCP server.

tools.name: sb_list_public_apps
tools.description: Find Software Belongs apps in the approved public deployment catalog. Returns descriptions and links, not file contents or execution.
